channel.Description: The label for a channel composed of two optodes, one source and one detector. Pattern is source number (Sx) then detector number (Dx) separated by an underscore (_).

l_tpj_distance.Description: Euclidean distance of point of measurement (midway between source and detector) to centre of left TPJ ROI in mm.

r_tpj_distance.Description: Euclidean distance of point of measurement (midway between source and detector) to centre of right TPJ ROI in mm.

l_ifg_distance.Description: Euclidean distance of point of measurement (midway between source and detector) to centre of left IFG ROI in mm.

r_ifg_distance.Description: Euclidean distance of point of measurement (midway between source and detector) to centre of right IFG ROI in mm.
